Dikshitar’s study of the Matsya Purāṇa, its contents, its accounts of the dynasties, of the Flood, of temple building and of the arts, and its place among the Purāṇas (Madras, 1935). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Matsya Purana · Dikshitar,v.r.ramachandra · 1935, 156 scanned pages. Published 1935; V. R. Ramachandra Dikshitar died 1953; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
